strings.settings.ai.modelHint: Pick a model from the gateway list. Free models end in :free and change over time.
strings.settings.language.note: Languages are loaded from the i18n folder (drop-in JSON files). The switch applies immediately where possible; timecodes always stay SMPTE-style.
strings.settings.privacy.note: AI requests are text-only (transcripts, subtitle lines, metadata). Media files are never uploaded. The API key is stored with Windows Credential Manager (DPAPI) on Windows and is never written to logs.
